_notes: DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Enable deliberately by removing the '_disabled' field.
Only acts when BRAINROT_AUTO_LESSON=true, so finishing a task never spends speech credits by surprise.
Missing Brainrotten companion must NOT block coding work.

action.prompt: A spec task was just completed. Only if BRAINROT_AUTO_LESSON=true is set (or the task explicitly asks for a video), explain this task's change as a Brainrotten video using the brainrotten MCP server: pick the format (code changed -> prreview, parts interacting -> groupchat, architecture -> sketch, options weighed -> tierlist, concept -> skit), call get_video_formats for that format and copy its storyExample structure, write the full script from the real change, call validate_video_script and fix every issue, then call generate_short_video once and report the job id. Otherwise do nothing. If the companion is not reachable, skip silently.
